intent: A gilded hedge labyrinth in the Eternal Domain that is a genuinely different maze on every seed, entered through white marble gateways and centred on a winged gold idol with holy pollen drifting in the lanes.

critic.best_shot: feature-shots-final: idol rising over the hedge maze
critic.why: A genuinely different maze each seed; the heavy green fights the ivory and gold palette.

role: Garden side area: hedge maze as an optional detour with a reward at the idol.
notes:
# W

Keep: Keep the per-seed maze generation and the marble gateways.

1. Lighten the hedges or gild their tops so they belong to the Domain palette.
2. Make the idol read: wings and a clear head; it reads as a gold torch.
3. Widen lanes for fights; tight corridors will choke packs.
